purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system - CLAIM connection settings screen (CLAIM接続設定, P02X screen)
purpose.summary: This program implements the CLAIM connection settings screen (P02X) within the JMA ORCA patient registration subsystem. It reads system management table (tbl_syskanri) records to populate connection settings (address, port, memo), handles screen initialization, input validation, and registration of CLAIM connection parameters. It supports EUC, S-ORCA, and FTE-8 send code options.

notable_features: Heavy use of COPY statements (32 copybooks) for screen and data layouts
LINKAGE SECTION with MCPAREA, SPAAREA, LINKAREA, SCRAREA parameters
EVALUATE on MCP-STATUS/MCP-EVENT for screen navigation
Japanese text in comments (EUC-JP encoding, decoded as latin-1)
DB access via PERFORM 910-DBSELECT-SEC pattern (MCP abstraction layer)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS - uses MCP abstraction
verdict.notes: Source file is encoded in EUC-JP but was decoded as latin-1, causing mojibake in Japanese comment text. This is characteristic of JMA ORCA source files. The file was truncated at 16000 chars out of 25002 bytes. Program is a subprogram called via LINKAGE SECTION with multiple areas passed as parameters, functioning as an online screen handler within the ORCA MCP framework rather than traditional CICS.
